data.narrative:
Hades Mining is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $22M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Climate & Energy peer universe of 9 companies (1 public: Linzagroup; 8 private including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix), though a sufficiently narrow peer cohort at identical stage and valuation tier was not available to support a robust peer-median approach.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach, using the $22M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for advancement from Seed to the subsequent stage. This yields an implied valuation of $55M. Absent sufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage comparable data within Climate & Energy, the peer-median method was not applied to avoid relying on a broader cohort that would obscure material differences in deployment capital, technology readiness, and market risk.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $47M to $63M, with a median point of $55M. The substantial gap between low and high estimates reflects the single-method foundation and the early stage of the business. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to the peer set, technology differentiation within the crowded climate-tech subsector, and path-to-profitability visibility. A more refined valuation would require either narrower peer comparables at Hades' stage or material operational milestones that reduce valuation dispersion.
